description: Use this when someone asks what size pool pump they need or what flow rate turns their pool over in a given number of hours. Takes gallons and turnover hours (default 8). Returns gallons per minute, gallons per hour, a rule-of-thumb horsepower range, the minimum sand, cartridge and DE filter area for that flow, and pipe velocities. Not for electricity cost or pump model recommendations.

gallons.description: Pool volume in US gallons (from pool_volume if the user gave dimensions).

turnover_hours.description: Hours for one full turnover (default 8; 6 for heavy use).

name: pump_size

link.description: Page of calculatepool.com for the same calculation.

title: Pool pump flow rate
